days.title: Glendalough Monastic Valley
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Glendalough
stops.detail: It lies in the heart of the Wicklow Mountains in County Wicklow in eastern Ireland, which were largely formed during the Caledonian orogeny in the Paleozoic era, with a visitor center at Glendalough, which can be translated as "Valley of the Two Lakes."

stops.name: Lower Lake
stops.detail: The collection of 6th-century monastic ruins at the Lower Lake is one of the most famous on the island.

stops.name: Derrybawn Mountain
stops.detail: It stands south of St. Kevin's Church at the foot of Derrybawn Mountain (Sliabh Dhoire Bán), next to the Glenealo River.

days.title: Upper Lake Shores
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Upper Lake
stops.detail: The archaeological monument is located next to the Upper Lake.

stops.name: Reefert Church
stops.detail: The remains of Reefert Church (Teampall Rífhearta) are located in a wooded area on the southeastern shore of the Upper Lake.

stops.name: Templenaskellig
stops.detail: The ruins of the small church Templenaskellig (Teampall na Sceilge) lie at the foot of the cliffs on the southern shore of the Upper Lake.
